messages:
Anya: hey team — I pulled a new public weight dump called sapphire-13b that the research team wants to try in staging. quick heads-up: before we start quant experiments + evals, can legal/ops confirm any hard constraints on reuse, quantization, or serving?
Matt: do you have the upstream repo/link + model card? that speeds up checks.
Anya: yep: https://example.com/sapphire-13b and model_card.md attached in the repo. PD says 'permissive-but-check-derivatives' in the note. :thinking_face:
Jess: hosted vs. private deployment matters. if it's permissive but forbids rehosting, we might need Dedicated/Private only. what's the ask?
Anya: first step is quantize and run our eval harness in staging only. later we can propose hosting.
LegalBot: automated scan results: header found: terms = "custom-CC-NC-1.0" (non-commercial clause present). provenance metadata incomplete (no dataset manifest). recommended manual review: export_control_check, derivation_clause_check. see /legal/scans/1719304821/report.txt
Carlos: NC clause is a blocker for hosted commercial API. for Dedicated/internal dev we could still run, but can't offer to customers. also need to confirm whether fork/derivative models are allowed after quantization.
Kim: quick manual checklist proposal so we don't miss things:```yaml
- confirm_full_text: true
- export_control: manual_review
- training_data_piis: triage_required
- derivative_restrictions: allowed/forbidden
- commercial_reuse: yes/no
- attribution_requirements: text
- sha256_of_weights: required
```
Kim: assign owners: Anya -> gather artifacts + sha256, Matt -> infra constraints (hosted vs private), Carlos -> AM legal sync, Jess -> staging run config.
Matt: infra note: if we keep it private for now, we can still run quantization batches on dedicated nodes. need approximate memory/throughput numbers from the eval.
Anya: will produce sha256 and link to training-data-claim doc by EOD.
Carlos: booking 30-min with Legal (Maya) at 15:30 PT to go over non-commercial clause and export risk. cc @Maya if she wants to join earlier.
Jess: when you post the sha256, please include the exact git tag or commit for the loader code we use. otherwise we can't reproduce quant results.
Anya: got it — will post: `sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...` and tag `sapphire/initial-eval`
LegalBot: note: non-commercial clauses MAY restrict internal productization depending on customer intent. manual review outcome: likely "internal R&D OK, commercial hosting NO" but final signoff needed.
Matt: small ops checklist for quant stage: `curl -X POST /inference/prepare -d '{"model":"sapphire-13b","mode":"quant-test"}'` then run eval harness. include eval seed and prompt set.
Kim: also track a "quality-regression" test in the PR — baseline vs quantized metrics and a short failing-case list.
Anya: ok planning: run quantized eval in staging, collect metrics + failing cases, meet with Legal after their review. I'll update this thread when sha256 and model card augmentations are up. :thumbsup:
Carlos: thanks — I'll take notes during the legal sync and post summary here. :eyes:
Anya: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
